claims.text: Override log contract: overrides.jsonl (0600) records seq, account, line, old and new category, reason, typed name, OS user, UTC time and the statement's sha256; each is appended under the case lock with a case-log entry carrying the record's hash; categories must be valid for the line's direction (credit: has a money-in bucket; debit: not money-in-only); a missing line, empty reason or name, unknown category, stale expected log position (LogConflict) or refused case-log append records nothing; an identical override records nothing; a hand-edited record is refused naming it, and a record the case log never recorded is ignored as a leftover. Stale overrides (line gone, or statement hash changed) are not applied and are listed until confirmed (only when the line is still there) or dropped. Figures/monthly cells resting on an overridden line are marked. CLI: cma case override / overrides / resolve-override / figures.
claims.proof_cmd: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_overrides.py tests/test_case_store.py tests/test_cli.py

claims.text: Lint and the full suite pass.
claims.proof_cmd: ruff check src tests && python -m compileall -q src && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider

notes: Design choices: (1) For each (account, line) the latest override decides; earlier ones are 'superseded'; a dropped latest override leaves the line to the rules. (2) An override's basis is the statement file's sha256 at record time, or at its latest confirm; a confirm is refused when the line is gone or the category is no longer valid for its direction. (3) A figure or monthly cell is marked when an applied override's line is in its evidence OR its value/evidence differs from the same computation with no overrides (so M25 is marked when a credit leaves unexplained money in). (4) The case-log entry carries every record field except the reason, plus the record's sha256; the reason lives in overrides.jsonl, bound by that hash. (5) Figures are per account (each account's statement computed on its own, with the case profile); combining accounts is R41 (Tier 2) and not built here. Indicators and the policy check are recomputed by T22's workspace from case_figures; this task recomputes metrics M1-M28 and the monthly summary. The full-suite run was taken just before a one-line ruff fix (an unused loop variable) in overrides.py; ruff and the 103 related tests were rerun after it.
